name: Corruption Scars
summary: At Corruption 3 or when a rule specifically causes a scar, choose a fitting consequence with the GM: visible mutation, recurring hallucination, warp-sensitive wound, compulsive ritual, psychic echo, social stigma or another narrow effect. A scar should produce decisions and roleplay without making a character mechanically unusable.
